The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''20,100 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]]. By that time, the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] had been largely settled.<ref name="atlas119">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
